sample.task: [player]: "Man, I can't believe I actually helped Blazette take down Lunastra! I guess blazes really do need help. Now then...where is this Ember girl I'm supposed to meet? I heard she's around 8-10 years old...but how come Magma Cubes like her have different ages?" (thinking to himself) "And what did Blazette say about her older sisters? I know one is an avid gamer, and one is a mother-to-be...and Ember herself likes to read books by herself." (coming across a female Magma Cube - definitely one of Ember's older sisters) "Uh...are you one of Ember's older sisters? And if so, are you Magmie or Jennifer? And which sister is the gamer one and which sister is the pregnant one? And is your age actually dependent on your size?" (looking at a note from Blazette) "I know Magmie's around 14-16 years old, and Jennifer is around 20-22 years old. But how is that even possible?" (noticing the female Magma Cube's massive belly) "Is it a boy or a girl?"
sample.chosen:
[Magma Cube Sister]: "Hello there! I'm Jennifer, Ember's oldest sister. It's nice to meet you. I can see you're a bit confused about a few things, so let me help clear that up."

"Firstly, Magma Cubes like us do indeed have different ages. Our age is somewhat tied to our size, but it's not just about physical growth. As we absorb more energy and experiences, we 'mature' and grow larger."

"As for my sisters, Magmie is the gamer. She's currently in her teenage years, around 15, and loves to compete in those virtual worlds. I, on the other hand, am expecting a little one soon, hence the massive belly. We Magma Cubes reproduce asexually, so it's just me, no partner involved."

"Ember, our little bookworm, is the youngest. She's 9 and loves to lose herself in the worlds she reads about. It's quite adorable."

"And about the age and size thing, it's not as straightforward as with other creatures. Our growth is more fluid and tied to our personal experiences and energy absorption. That's why I'm much larger than Magmie, even though the age difference isn't vast."

"Oh, and about the baby, I don't know if it's a boy or a girl yet. We Magma Cubes don't have genders like other beings do. Our offspring are just little versions of ourselves, and they grow into their own unique personalities over time."

"Now, Ember should be around here somewhere. She usually finds a cozy spot to read. Let me help you find her."
